pages.title: Argo Orchestrator Architecture
pages.content:
# Argo Orchestrator

Argo Orchestrator schedules and runs internal workflows. Every workflow receives a service token before any task begins.

## Dependency

Argo Orchestrator consumes Auth API v1 from Auth Service. Its token client calls POST /v1/auth from story-labs/argo-orchestrator/src/token_client.py. The dependency was introduced by ARGO-201.

Argo has not adopted Auth API v2. A removal of v1 would block new workflow execution.

pages.title: Argo Authentication Failure Runbook
pages.content:
# Authentication failure handling

When POST /v1/auth is unavailable, Argo marks the workflow blocked and does not run tasks. Operators should verify Auth Service health and the service credential.

ARGO-202 documents this behavior. The runbook assumes Auth API v1 remains available.
